amb_a1_claw.001: This claw machine is rigged. I can feel it.
amb_a1_claw.003: Four. Don't round down to be nice.
amb_a1_charger.001: Does anyone have a charger? I'm at nine percent.
amb_a1_charger.003: Why do you always have one?
amb_a1_schedule.001: We have until five. I'm making a timetable.
amb_a1_schedule.002: Can the timetable have snacks in it?
amb_a1_crackers.003: The ones in your hand, Justin.
amb_a1_turn.001: Hyunjun. The turn from last week. Watch.
amb_a1_wall.001: Wait, what's happening? Why is the wall glowing?
amb_a1_wall.002: It's been glowing for twenty minutes.
amb_a1_coat.003: Put it on the radiator. Please.
amb_a1_flyer.001: This flyer is for a film night. Eight years ago.
amb_a1_flyer.002: Someone should really take it down.
amb_a1_flyer.003: I think it's nice that nobody did.
amb_a1_speakers.001: If it's a speaker array, where are the speakers?
amb_a1_speakers.002: Maybe the building's just like that.

amb_a1_selfie.002: I can't look mysterious. My face won't do it.
amb_a1_selfie.003: Try looking hungry. Basically the same.
amb_a1_sofa.001: This sofa has a spring that bites.
amb_a1_sofa.003: How do you already know that?
amb_a1_rain.003: Anyone can leave. Nobody wants to.
amb_a2e_hum.001: Can anyone else hear the doors humming?
amb_a2e_diagnostic.003: Polite building. I keep saying it.
amb_a2e_hungry.002: You are. You just haven't noticed yet.

amb_a2e_claw.002: It just picked up nothing again.
amb_a2e_premiss.001: Is it weird that I miss ECHO already?
amb_a2e_stairs.001: The third stair from the top creaks.
amb_a2e_stairs.003: We should warn Daniel. He jumps them.
amb_a2e_eightcount.003: The lobby has the best floor in the building.
amb_a2e_rule.001: I've written "rule one" on every page.
amb_a2e_rule.003: So I never forget it's the rule.
amb_a2e_pocket.003: It's crinkling in the exact shape of jelly.
amb_a2e_quiet.002: It's okay to be quiet sometimes.
amb_a2e_upstairs.001: Wait, what's happening? Is someone going upstairs?
amb_a2e_upstairs.003: Okay. But tell me first next time.
amb_a2e_tea.001: The kettle in the lounge still works.
amb_a2e_strawberry.001: My hair looks like a wet strawberry.
amb_a2l_fort.001: Nobody touch the fort. The fort has rules.
amb_a2l_ghost.003: Then not a ghost. Case closed.
amb_a2l_floor.001: If I lie down, I'm not getting up.
amb_a2l_shoes.001: I've started hiding snacks in my shoes.
amb_a2l_plugged.002: It's already plugged in. By your hand.
amb_a2l_note.001: I keep thinking about her library note.
amb_a2l_note.003: I'd like to be that sure about anything.
amb_a2l_touched.001: I almost had it. The claw touched it.
amb_a2l_card.001: One card. Just one. That's so small.
amb_a2l_hour.001: It's so quiet at this hour.
amb_a2l_hour.002: The vending machine's the loudest thing now.
amb_a2l_hour.003: Like a film, just before the music starts.
amb_a2l_lying.001: Wait, what's happening? Why is everyone lying down?
amb_a2l_lying.002: It's nearly three. This is what three looks like.
amb_a2l_fiveminutes.001: I haven't talked for five whole minutes.
amb_a2l_goodnight.001: ECHO just said "goodnight" to the vending machine.
